title: Performance To Quality Ratio
description: High performance Fabric 1.21.11 modpack focused on maintaining visual quality while maximizing FPS. Multiplayer friendly with minimal performance loss.
body:
Summary:
High-performance Fabric modpack focused on maximizing FPS while keeping Minecraft visually appealing.

Description:
Performance To Quality Ratio is a Fabric 1.21.11 modpack designed to improve FPS without heavily sacrificing visuals.

Includes:
• Optimization mods
• Visual improvements
• Multiplayer support
• QoL features
• Better chunk handling
• Performance tuning

Built to balance quality and performance for smoother gameplay.
